authority: Explicit owner screenshot-first request permits read-only installed capability discovery and visible-display capture/transfer; no new payload, UI action or broad process-memory dump
targetScript:
set -eu
for utility in screenshot fbgrab fb2png rmfb2png remarkable-screenshot remarkable-capture grim dbus-send qdbus qdbus6 gdb fbset busybox; do
  location=$(command -v "$utility" || true)
  if test -n "$location"; then printf 'UTILITY %s %s\n' "$utility" "$location"; fi
done
for node in /dev/fb0 /dev/fb1 /dev/dri/card0 /dev/dri/card1 /sys/class/graphics/fb0/name /sys/class/graphics/fb0/virtual_size /sys/class/graphics/fb0/bits_per_pixel; do
  if test -e "$node"; then stat -c 'CAPABILITY_NODE %n %F %a %u %g' "$node"; fi
done
stdout:
UTILITY screenshot /usr/bin/screenshot
UTILITY dbus-send /usr/bin/dbus-send
UTILITY fbset /usr/sbin/fbset
UTILITY busybox /usr/bin/busybox
CAPABILITY_NODE /dev/dri/card0 character special file 660 0 44
